_comment: Injury type definitions used by engine/injuries.js (picking a random injury when a player goes down) and the Hospital tab (ui/hospitalUI.js). Optional — the app ships with an embedded fallback copy of this list in js/state.js, so editing this file works without a rebuild, same as leagues.json/managers.json/trophies.json.

injuries.name: Muscle Cramp
injuries.description: Sudden involuntary muscle contraction, usually brought on by fatigue or dehydration late in a match.
causes: felt a muscle seize up and had to be withdrawn as a precaution
was struck down by cramp late in the match
signalled to the bench after his leg locked up

injuries.name: Ankle Sprain
injuries.description: A stretching or partial tearing of the ligaments around the ankle joint.
causes: rolled his ankle after a heavy tackle
twisted his ankle awkwardly on the turf
went over on his ankle challenging for the ball
landed badly after an aerial duel and turned his ankle

injuries.name: Knee Knock
injuries.description: A bruising blow to the knee from a direct collision, with no ligament damage.
causes: took a knock on the knee in a goalmouth scramble
was caught by a stray boot on the knee
clattered knees with an opponent going for a header

injuries.name: Dead Leg (Contusion)
injuries.description: A deep muscle bruise caused by a direct blow to the thigh, temporarily numbing the leg.
causes: took a stray knee to the thigh and needed treatment
was caught by a heavy challenge on the thigh
picked up a dead leg after a collision

injuries.name: Concussion Protocol
injuries.description: Withdrawn as a head-injury precaution to be assessed under concussion protocol.
causes: clashed heads with an opponent and was taken off for a head-injury assessment
took a blow to the head in an aerial challenge
was withdrawn as a precaution after a heavy fall

injuries.name: Hamstring Strain
injuries.description: A partial tear of the hamstring muscle fibres, typically from an explosive sprint.
causes: pulled up sharply while chasing a through ball
felt his hamstring go mid-sprint
pulled up holding the back of his leg after a burst of pace
stretched to reach a pass and felt his hamstring tighten

injuries.name: Calf Strain
injuries.description: A tear in the calf muscle fibres, often from a sudden push-off or change of direction.
causes: pulled up with a tight calf after pushing off to sprint
felt his calf tighten and signalled to the bench
was substituted after feeling a twinge in his calf

injuries.name: Groin Strain
injuries.description: A tear in the groin muscles, commonly caused by a sudden stretch or change of direction.
causes: felt his groin go while stretching for the ball
pulled up sharply after a lunging challenge
was withdrawn after a sharp pain in his groin

injuries.name: Thigh Strain
injuries.description: A muscle tear in the front or back of the thigh from a sudden burst of effort.
causes: pulled up with a tight thigh chasing back
felt his quad tighten after a shot
was caught mid-stride by a muscle strain in his thigh

injuries.name: Back Spasm
injuries.description: An involuntary muscle spasm in the lower back, often from an awkward twist or landing.
causes: landed awkwardly and felt his back seize up
was withdrawn after his back locked up mid-match
twisted awkwardly clearing the ball and felt his back go

injuries.name: Shoulder Injury
injuries.description: Bruising or a mild joint sprain in the shoulder from a heavy fall or collision.
causes: landed heavily on his shoulder after a challenge
took a shoulder charge and needed treatment
fell awkwardly onto his shoulder in a goalmouth clash

injuries.name: Fractured Metatarsal
injuries.description: A break in one of the long bones of the foot, usually from a stray boot or a blocked shot.
causes: was caught late on the foot and immediately went down in pain
took a heavy stamp on the foot in a goalmouth scramble
twisted awkwardly and felt his foot give way

injuries.name: Knee Ligament Sprain (MCL)
injuries.description: A sprain of the medial collateral ligament from a sideways impact on a planted leg.
causes: was caught side-on by a heavy challenge on a planted leg
twisted awkwardly with his studs stuck in the turf
buckled at the knee after a sliding tackle from the side

injuries.name: Rib Fracture
injuries.description: A crack or break in a rib bone, usually from a direct collision or heavy fall.
causes: took an elbow to the ribs in an aerial duel
landed hard on an opponent's knee after a challenge
collided heavily with the goalkeeper going for the ball

injuries.name: Facial Fracture
injuries.description: A break to the bones of the face, typically from an accidental clash of heads or a stray elbow.
causes: clashed heads with an opponent going for the same ball
took an accidental elbow to the face
was caught flush in the face by a clearance

injuries.name: Hip Flexor Tear
injuries.description: A tear in the muscles connecting the thigh to the hip, from an explosive kicking or sprinting motion.
causes: felt his hip go through on an over-stretched clearance
pulled up sharply mid-sprint holding his hip
over-extended for a tackle and felt his hip flexor tear

injuries.name: ACL Tear
injuries.description: A tear of the anterior cruciate ligament — one of football's most serious injuries, usually needing surgery and months of rehab.
causes: planted awkwardly and his knee buckled with no one near him
landed from a jump with his knee twisting inward and went down clutching it
was caught with his studs stuck in the turf as his knee gave way

injuries.name: Achilles Tendon Rupture
injuries.description: A complete tear of the Achilles tendon, one of the longest lay-off injuries in the game.
causes: pushed off to sprint and went down instantly clutching his ankle
felt something snap in his heel with no contact from anyone
collapsed to the turf mid-stride grabbing the back of his ankle

injuries.name: Fractured Tibia/Fibula
injuries.description: A break to one or both of the lower leg bones, almost always from a serious, high-impact challenge.
causes: was caught by a reckless, high challenge on the lower leg
took the full force of a mistimed tackle on his shin
was on the end of a heavy, studs-up challenge
